notes.title: 0.38 - The Trials
notes.content:
Hello Droners,

Get ready for a massive update packed with improvements, new content, and an entirely reworked game mode—The Trials!

🔥 THE TRIALS 🔥
Training has evolved into a full-fledged game mode! Face The Trials, a series of challenging combat scenarios designed to push your skills and strategy to the limit. For the best shot at victory, a high-level Codex is highly recommended. Do you have what it takes to conquer them all?


🌌 NEW MAP: VOID ARENA
Introducing Void Arena, a brand-new battlefield designed to bring fresh intensity to your arena fights.


🌅 TIME OF DAY VARIATIONS
Battles just got more dynamic! Maps will now feature randomized times of day, adding variety and atmosphere to every encounter.

⚙️ MOD SYSTEM REWORK
I've refined the mod system for better clarity and balance. Instead of fully flexible slots, you’ll now have:

- 2 dedicated weapon mod slots
- 3 utility mod slots

This keeps customization powerful while making loadouts easier to manage.


🤖 ARBITER UPGRADES
Your trusty Arbiter now has some more responsibilities ! 

During Trials, it will display your minimap to help navigate the battlefield.
At night, it will illuminate your path.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529984/8aa48da32431cced16f9f4b434c227892619fa8c.png[/img]


🛠️ NEW MODS
More Utility and Codex Mods have been added—experiment and find new ways to dominate the battlefield!

See you in the arena, pilots. Good luck in The Trials!

notes.title: 0.36 - The Arbiter Update
notes.content:
Hello Droners,

I'm excited to introduce The Arbiter Update—your drone's new, trusted companion on the battlefield! The Arbiter will shadow your drone, closely monitoring every move and ensuring you’re always one step ahead.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529984/3d7d3acdf798c2362865b5cfe26e31f9f45e0318.png[/img]

[b]What does the Arbiter bring to the table?[/b]

Enhanced utility: Certain utility & codex effects will now be managed by your Arbiter, adding a better visual effect to the  gameplay.
Future readiness: The Arbiter sets the stage for upcoming account flair options, so stay tuned!

Wishing you thrilling battles and happy gaming!
